patch_list: Neutralizes the app's explicit AppsFlyer start while keeping its existing opt-out and consent paths intact.
Stops non-rewarded banner and native ad requests at the load entry points, preserving UMP, interstitial and rewarded flows.
Disables Firebase Analytics collection through the SDK's official manifest flag, keeping push, remote config and the consent UI.
Disable PairIP license check in MyTherapy
Neutralizes the PairIP license check so the re-signed APK can start, without removing its components.
Prevents Sentry initialization at the app's single entry point, without removing its providers or native libraries.
Require explicit analytics consent in MyTherapy
Treats an unregistered analytics consent as opt-out, while preserving recorded acceptance and refusal.
Removes GAID and AdServices Ad ID permissions to reduce ad tracking, keeping attribution, topics and consent untouched.
Grants the local Plus state the app reads for ad-free access, extra calendar days and the PDF entry point.
